comparison.objective: Extract the bottom bar from a pile while supporting the bars above it.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support and constrained sliding extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Implied success is removal of the bottom bar without dropping the bars it carries.
comparison.reason: Load-supported extraction is unrelated to rotary damper tuning and locked impact validation. The body, numeric failure limits, release condition, and all specs are missing, but the stated objective is clearly different.
